name: ScalaHosting managed cloud
line: Run apps on a managed virtual server with SPanel and support.

cells.regions: US, Canada, EU, Asia, Australia; selector unclear
cells.selfhost: Yes; run apps on the managed VPS

work.math: $54.95 a month on the standard one-month rate. 100 GB of transfer is within the unmetered feature. Private-repo setup is handled by you or arranged with support.
The fixed plan for 730 hours has 2 dedicated cores and 4 GB of RAM. 100 GB is within unmetered transfer, but performance for one million requests is untested.
$54.95 a month is the VPS subtotal. Whether the app and database fit in 4 GB of RAM and 50 GB of storage is not verified. Included backup retention conflicts between 1 and 7 copies.
